title: Scope remux HEVC bitstream filter
summary: Scoped remux HEVC bitstream filtering to HEVC video output ordinals and added HEVC plus MJPEG cover-art regression coverage.
reason: Recent remux failures showed HEVC MKV sources with MJPEG cover-art video streams receiving the broad hevc_mp4toannexb bitstream filter, causing FFmpeg invalid-argument failures before publish.
behavior_before: The remux AV stage mapped video with 0:V and emitted an unscoped -bsf:v hevc_mp4toannexb whenever the source codec was HEVC, so FFmpeg applied the HEVC filter to non-HEVC mapped video streams such as MJPEG cover art.
behavior_after: The production remux AV stage maps video streams from the preflight video inventory by explicit source index, keeps attachment mapping unchanged, and applies hevc_mp4toannexb only to real HEVC output video ordinals. The dry-run plan executor now scopes its HEVC bitstream filter to v:0, and the MJPEG/HEVC bitstream-filter stderr signature classifies as REMUX_ATTACHED_PICTURE_MAPPED.
manual_validation: Real failure scoped-BSF FFmpeg check on Indiana Jones, Tales from Earthsea, The Raid, and The Shining: 8-second remux commands exited 0, preserved HEVC plus MJPEG video streams, and avoided broad -bsf:v; artifacts under E:\Videos\Scratch\State\Failures\Validation\MP-CHANGE-2026-0630-016.
rollback_plan: Revert the remux video argument helper, the plan-executor scoped filter change, the classifier pattern, the focused regression assertions, and the regenerated summaries in this packet; then rerun the same targeted PowerShell checks before retrying affected media.
notes:
Scoped remux HEVC bitstream filtering and classified MJPEG cover-art bitstream-filter failures.
Added focused HEVC plus MJPEG cover-art remux command and classifier regressions.
Refreshed generated summaries for changed remux, classifier, and test files.
Real-media validation remains required before rerunning affected production files because this changes FFmpeg remux stream mapping/media policy.
Change-packet validation passed with strict worktree coverage; unrelated dirty files are covered by existing packets outside this change.
Targeted real-media validation covers remux-AV command construction only; full pipeline publish/drain rerun remains outside this check.
